festas.name: Romaria em Honra de Nossa Senhora do Desterro
festas.usual: April, over a long weekend
festas.about: A romaria at the Capela da Senhora do Desterro (1663), which local legend says stands on the rock where the Virgin appeared. It draws many thousands of pilgrims and is run by the Irmandade de Nossa Senhora do Desterro.

2026.highlights: Sat 11 Apr: Grupo Trovão, singer Kássio, fireworks. Processions on Sunday 12 Apr (11h) and Monday 13 Apr (10h30). The 2026 edition put the stress on the religious side, with no big-name acts.

2025.highlights: religious programme organised by the Irmandade

festas.name: Dia da Freguesia de Arada / Festa de São Martinho
festas.usual: around 11 November (São Martinho's day)
festas.about: The parish day in honour of the patron São Martinho: flag-raising, a eucharist, a formal session and a port-wine reception.

2025.highlights: flag-raising, schoolchildren planting an olive tree, eucharist in honour of São Martinho, formal session

festas.name: Festas em Honra de Nossa Senhora da Nazaré (Festas do Mar de Cortegaça)
festas.usual: first weekend of September (Infopédia: first Sunday of September)
festas.about: Held for over 140 years at the beach chapel of Nossa Senhora da Nazaré. In 2025 OvarNews called it the biggest romaria in the region: a morning procession of more than twenty andores runs from the Souto to the beach, and an afternoon procession ends with the Bênção do Mar.

2026.highlights: Fri 4: Bruno Cordeiro, DJ H'Alma. Sat 5: DNA, midnight fireworks, DJ Sandro Amaral. Sun 6: 9h procession from Largo do Souto to the beach with Banda Boa União and the Esmoriz firefighters' fanfarra; solemn mass at the chapel; 16h procession with blessing of the sea; Nuno Ribeiro at 22h; piromusical fireworks; DJ Renato C. Mon 7: NovaSom Band, closing fireworks. Organised by the Comissão de Festas de Cortegaça.

festas.name: Festa de Santa Marinha
festas.usual: 18 July (Santa Marinha's day)
festas.about: Annual festa of the parish patron, centred on the Igreja Matriz de Santa Marinha (the azulejo-covered church), with processions, solemn masses and cultural events.

festas.name: Arraial da Barrinha
festas.usual: late June to early July
festas.about: A secular summer arraial of concerts by the beach, organised by the Junta de Freguesia de Esmoriz and the Câmara Municipal de Ovar. Not a saint's festa.

2026.highlights: Fósseis Modernos, Lean Cruz, Banda do Filme 'Variações', Joana Espadinha, Bruno Cordeiro, Doya, H1, NAPA, José Pinhal Post-Mortem Experience; Pedro Abrunhosa closes on 5 July

festas.name: Festas do Mar de Esmoriz (Senhor dos Aflitos e Senhora da Boa Viagem)
festas.honours: Senhor dos Aflitos and Nossa Senhora da Boa Viagem
festas.usual: end of August into early September (Infopédia: last Sunday of August for N. Sra. dos Aflitos)
festas.about: Esmoriz's seaside romaria. The Sunday procession, with andores and the Esmoriz firefighters' fanfarra, goes from the Igreja Matriz to the beach chapel and ends with the traditional blessing of the sea.

2025.highlights: Sunday procession from the Igreja Matriz to the beach chapel, then the bênção do mar; live concerts; several fireworks sessions; local artist Lean Cruz on the beach stage on the last night

festas.name: Festas em Honra de Nossa Senhora d'Ajuda
festas.usual: two weeks in September, main procession on the third Sunday
festas.about: The festa of Espinho's patron, protector of the sea trades, organised by the Município de Espinho: a candle procession, a flower carpet, a Majestosa Procissão with blessing of the sea, big concerts and fireworks at Praia da Baía.

2026.highlights: 13 Sep: romaria with folk groups. 16 Sep: candle procession. 17 Sep: Sinfónica 4500 with Paulo de Carvalho. 19 Sep: flower carpet, Rui Veloso, piromusical fireworks. 20 Sep: solemn mass, 16h30 Majestosa Procissão e Bênção do Mar, Vizinhos, fireworks. 21 Sep: re-creation of the Feira das Cebolas.

festas.name: Festas da Nossa Senhora do Mar
festas.usual: turn of July/August, ending on the first weekend of August
festas.about: The fishing quarter's festa for Nossa Senhora do Mar, with two processions, daily morteiros, concerts and a car raffle.

2025.highlights: 31 Jul: 21h procession. Then Bandalusa, Lean Cruz, Mastiksoul and Pé de Samba. Sun 3 Aug: Banda S. Tiago, Fanfarra BV Espinho, mass, rosary, 17h procession, AM Show. 4 Aug: Fusiforme.

festas.name: Festas de São Pedro d'Espinho
festas.usual: from 29 June (São Pedro's day) into the following weekend
festas.about: Espinho's São Pedro festa: a mass at the Capela de S. Pedro, a rusga, a talent contest, a field mass and procession, concerts and fireworks.

2026.highlights: 29 Jun: São Pedro mass. 2 Jul: Banda Remédio Santo. 3 Jul: arruada of the Rusga de São Pedro. 4 Jul: Maré de Talentos, Banda Myllenium, fireworks. 5 Jul: 11h field mass, 16h30 procession, Zé Amaro, fireworks.

festas.name: Festas de Santo António (Estarreja)
festas.usual: first half of June, up to Santo António's day (13 June) and the municipal holiday
festas.about: Estarreja's town and municipal festas for Santo António: an old-time market, marchas populares, tasquinhas, an ethnographic parade and concerts, ending with the religious celebrations and the Dia do Município.

2026.highlights: Mercado Antigo (5–7 Jun); 'Bandas em Festa' with the three municipal bands; Galandum Galundaina; ethnographic parade; community show '(A)braços da Ria'; concerts and marchas; closing religious celebrations

festas.name: Festas do Mar do Furadouro (Senhora e Senhor da Piedade)
festas.honours: Nossa Senhora da Piedade and Senhor da Piedade
festas.usual: early to mid-September, main weekend around the second weekend of September
festas.about: The fishing community's sea festival. On Friday night two candle processions leave the Capela dos Campos (Ovar) and the Furadouro chapel and meet at Carregal. On Sunday a solemn procession gives the blessing of the sea from the central breakwater, over a traditional flower carpet.

2026.highlights: Sat 5: lighting ceremony, Swaly and DJ Dias. Fri 11: candle processions, Banda Tieta do Agreste. Sat 12: Miguel Ramiro, Bruno Azevedo, Banda GPS, midnight fireworks at the Paredão Marítimo Central. Sun 13: 11h field mass, 15h30 Majestosa Procissão with bênção do mar (Fanfarra BV Ovar, Banda Boa União), Beto Rocha, Banda Time. Mon 14: Grupo Sigma, closing morteiros. Organised by the Comissão Amigos do Furadouro.

festas.name: Festas em Honra de Nossa Senhora da Ajuda (Guilhovai)
festas.usual: June
festas.about: June festa in the lugar of Guilhovai; in 2022 Quim Barreiros gave a free concert there, paid for by the câmara.

festas.name: Festa de São Pedro em Maceda
festas.usual: late June, around 29 June (São Pedro's day)
festas.about: Maceda's São Pedro festa, with marchas populares, concerts and fireworks. On the saint's day there is a solemn mass at the Igreja Matriz followed by a procession.

2025.highlights: 27 Jun marchas populares; 28 Jun Os Artistas da Rádio e Televisão, Jorge Bandeira, Lean Cruz, fireworks 23:50; 29 Jun 21-shot salute, 11h solemn mass at the Igreja Matriz, procession around 12h

festas.name: Festas em Honra da Senhora da Saúde
festas.usual: mid-August
festas.about: A summer festa in Maceda for Nossa Senhora da Saúde. The only detail found so far is one concert from the 2025 edition.

2025.highlights: Cláudia Nayara performed on Saturday 16 August 2025

festas.name: Festas em Honra de Santa Marinha (Marinha de Ovar)
festas.usual: mid-July, Thursday to Monday around Santa Marinha's day
festas.about: Festa of the lugar da Marinha in Ovar, beside the Ovar canal of the Ria. The Sunday has a sermon, mass and procession with the Ovar firefighters' fanfarra, and there are popular concerts each night.

2025.highlights: Fri: CS Band, Elena Correia. Sat: Grupo Lux. Sun: 15h30 sermon, mass and procession with Fanfarra BV Ovar; Broa de Mel at 22h, then Tanya. Mon: Grupo Menta Freska.

festas.name: Festas de Santa Catarina
festas.usual: late November, around 25 November (Santa Catarina's day)
festas.about: Yearly festa of the lugar da Ribeira in Ovar, kept going by volunteers; the 2025 edition was run by six young locals.

2025.highlights: Saturday headliner Rosinha, then fireworks and a night arraial with DJ Rafa Figueiredo

festas.name: Festa das Fogaceiras
festas.usual: 20 January (São Sebastião's day), with a programme all January
festas.about: A vow to São Sebastião kept for over five centuries: about 250 girls in white carry fogaças (sweet bread) on their heads from the Câmara to the Igreja Matriz, a solemn mass blesses them, and a procession goes through the historic centre.

2026.highlights: 10h30 civic cortege, 11h solemn mass with blessing of the fogaças, 15h30 Procissão das Fogaceiras. The month-long programme ended on 31 Jan with Fernando Daniel and the four municipal bands at Europarque.

festas.name: Arraial de São João de Ovar
festas.usual: around 20–23 June, before São João's day
festas.about: Four days of sanjoanino arraial in the Largo de São João: folklore, marchas, music, food, and a solemn eucharist and procession for São João Batista.

2026.highlights: 20 Jun: folklore festival 'Cancioneiro de Ovar', DJ Brito. 21 Jun: Banda Boa União, 9h30 eucaristia solene and procession, children's marchas populares, Duo Expresso 23. 22 Jun: Haja Baile Trio. 23 Jun: Banda Nelly Correia.

festas.name: Festas em Honra de São Tiago
festas.usual: late July, around 25 July (São Tiago's day)
festas.about: Silvalde's patronal festa: a solemn eucharist on São Tiago's day, a Sunday procession with the Banda Musical de S. Tiago de Silvalde, nightly concerts and fireworks.

2026.highlights: 24 Jul: Nuno Ribeiro, Pé de Samba. 25 Jul: solemn eucharist for São Tiago, Bandalusa, fireworks, DJ SU. 26 Jul: 16h30 procession with Fanfarra de Vilar de Andorinho and Banda de S. Tiago de Silvalde, Sons do Minho. 27 Jul: raffle, Bandaneia.

festas.name: Festas em Honra de Nossa Senhora da Boa Viagem
festas.usual: end of August into early September; it opens Ovar's Festas do Mar season
festas.about: Festa of the fishing hamlet between the sea and the Ria, with devotions and concerts. OvarNews's 2026 guide says the Festas do Mar started here from 28 August.

2025.highlights: Ruben Pinto (from Maceda), Brazilian singer Marcus, other artists; religious programme

festas.name: Romaria de São Paio da Torreira
festas.usual: early September, ending on 8 September
festas.about: The best-known lagoon festa of the Ria de Aveiro and one of Portugal's biggest romarias: rusgas, chinchorro and bateira sailing races, the moliceiro regatta and panel contest, fireworks over the sea and over the ria, and a closing procession.

2026.highlights: Chinchorro race; moliceiro regatta and panel contest; bateira sailing regatta; rusgas contest. Fogo do Mar (night of 5/6) and Fogo da Ria (night of 7/8). Revenge of the 90's, Edmundo Inácio, Marisa Liz, David Antunes, Toy. 8 Sep: field mass and majestic procession.

festas.name: Festas em Honra de Nossa Senhora do Amparo
festas.usual: mid-August, around 15 August
festas.about: Válega's patronal festa. Thousands follow the procession through the town centre over carpets of coloured salt made by the valeguenses; there is an ethnographic parade and a mass for emigrants.

2026.highlights: Sat 15 Aug: 16h solemn mass, then procession with Banda de São João de Loure and Fanfarra de Lourosa over salt carpets; Bruna and Nuno Portugal; midnight fireworks. Sun 16: mass for emigrants, 17h cortejo etnográfico, Os Solitários. Mon 17: Irmãos Leais, closing fireworks.

festas.name: Festas em Honra de São Miguel
festas.usual: end of September into early October, around São Miguel's day (29 September)
festas.about: A romaria at the Capela de São Miguel, one of the oldest chapels in the municipality (documented in 1002), revived by a committee of five young locals after a hiatus.

2026.highlights: 29 Sep: 21-shot salute, 20h solemn mass. 2 Oct: Grupo Trovão, fireworks. 3 Oct: Bombos de N. Sra. do Desterro, Banda MP3, fireworks. 4 Oct: bands, 15h30 solemn mass and procession, Banda Tita do Agreste, fireworks.
